title: Rory and the Star Blossom Glade
verses:
The sun dipped away past the rim of the hill,
The forest was cozy and deep,
As Rory led quietly into the glade,
Where star blossoms drifted to sleep.

High over the branches did Nia drift down,
On wings that were silver and slow,
To gaze at the blankets of blossoms beneath,
That lit with a delicate glow.

And Ricky was hopping right over a log,
Then curled on a carpet of green,
While Psittaco nestled right into the buds,
The softest that ever was seen.

Then Benny stepped softly and leaned near the bank,
Beside where the water ran clear,
While Tilly lay down in the petals of blue,
And knew that the night-time was near.

Together the friends gave a slow, sleepy yawn,
In peace as the shadows grew long,
While Rory hummed low to the darkening skies,
A soothing and slumbering song.

The blossoms were quiet, the breeze floated by,
The stars twinkled high overhead,
And Rory was smiling and closing his eyes,
Asleep in the velvety bed.
